patch.value: Measure all authored source and internal declarations before release approval

Current coverage-gate sources=[.] silently skips scripts by DEFAULT_SKIP_DIRS and certifies only index.ts. It reports lines/branches/functions but has no independent statement metric. Docstring analyzer reports 7 files and 51 selected declarations, without proving all internal declarations. This is a release blocker under the complete-source quality mandate and follows the narrower completed pm-slack-hn3n work.

Every authored executable TypeScript file including scripts is enumerated in per-file coverage; Statements branches functions and lines are actually measured and all reach 100 percent; Documentation denominator includes all internal documentable declarations and modules; Applicable lint duplication pm-lint security and platform gates run fail-closed locally and in CI with deliberately broken fixtures
Current measurement denominator omits operational scripts and independent statements and does not prove full internal documentation
